scope: Android phone launcher, native splash, and local working-session avatar only

icon.normalization: Original RGB pixels retained; PNG metadata omitted; source file unchanged
icon.legacyLauncher: Original complete composition, Lanczos resized to 48/72/96/144/192 px
icon.adaptiveForeground: Actual art isolated from perimeter-connected light backdrop, cropped to the illustration region, largest connected opaque subject retained, and Lanczos fitted to 240x240 within a transparent 432x432 canvas
icon.monochrome: White alpha silhouette of the same isolated supplied art, not a substitute symbol
icon.splash: Existing native splash directly references the new launcher; no startup delay added

workingAvatar.normalization: Byte-for-byte copy; all frames, palette transparency, disposal, cadence and looping retained
workingAvatar.runtime: Flutter Image.asset incremental shared image stream; requested cacheWidth256 is codec/backend dependent. TickerMode gates running, accessibility, lifecycle and covered-route motion
